name: brand-spoof-leadgen
description: Modelled on a real message that the engine originally scored 24/100 (low risk). Sender name asserts a financial brand ('Fidelity Life Offer') that is not in the brand table, from an unrelated random domain, with a repeated-fragment local part, an evasion-formatted subject, and every link plain HTTP to the same unknown host. Nothing here is brand-list-dependent, which is the point: this is the case that motivated identity.unsupported_org_claim. Also carries the two pre-normalisation signals: randomised address case and a padded subject, both of which the adapter's normalisation would otherwise erase. Recipient name redacted; body paraphrased, sender/subject/link shape verbatim.
